newsitem.title: USA: WMX CEO would give up duties to new CEO - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: WMX CEO would give up duties to new CEO - WSJ.

text.p: WMX Technologies founder and chief executive Dean Buntrock is prepared to hand over management duties in order to attract a strong CEO candidate, the Wall Street Journal said in Friday's electronic edition.
Buntrock, 65, has said he would stay on as chairman until 70, the paper said.
But he was quoted in the newspaper as saying: "I want to get the best CEO we can get. That's my objective. I'd like to stay on the board. All options are open."
He said he did not plan to be involved in the management of the company after it hired a new CEO, the paper said.
